description: This file defines a Python class 'PythonDispatcher' that acts as a binding to a C++ dispatcher for managing kernel dispatch keys in PyTorch. It includes methods for registration, retrieving registration info, and dispatch tables, primarily for debugging and testing purposes.

classes.name: PythonDispatcher
classes.description: A class providing an API to interact with the C++ dispatcher, including registration of kernels and retrieval of dispatch tables.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a list of supported dispatch keys.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers kernels to specified dispatch keys, with validation for duplicates and supported keys.

methods.name: rawRegistrations
methods.description: Returns raw registration info for debugging.

methods.name: rawDispatchTable
methods.description: Returns raw dispatch table info for debugging.

methods.name: registrations
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of all registered kernels, including alias keys.

methods.name: dispatchTable
methods.description: Returns the computed dispatch table, decoding alias keys to runtime keys.
